name: Whiskerhold
summary: Whiskerhold is the contractor base territory and the starting foothold for the round.
role: Use Whiskerhold as the fallback spawn and regroup point. It is spawn-only, so it anchors the team but does not count as a reclaimed objective.
fun_facts: Whiskerhold is the only territory flagged as spawn-only.
Furry players cannot deploy from Whiskerhold.

name: Furward
summary: Furward is the first reclaimable Furry-held territory after Whiskerhold.
role: Taking Furward opens an early forward deployment option and gives the team a shorter route back into the street fight.
fun_facts: Furward is active in the full territory route but not the single-objective Rush version.

name: Furrow
summary: Furrow is the third flag territory and the single active objective in Rush.
role: In Traditional, Furrow is one step in the territory chain. In Rush, it is the entire match: defenders hold it, Furries try to flip it once.
fun_facts: Rush starts Furrow in defender hands and ends badly if the Furries take it.

name: Purridge
summary: Purridge is a mid-route territory in the full Traditional push.
role: Hold Purridge to keep the team from respawning too far behind the front. Losing it can stretch rotations between Furrow and Whisken.
fun_facts: Purridge has more deploy spawn points than the first three flags.

name: Whisken
summary: Whisken is the fifth flag territory and a late-midpoint forward spawn.
role: Use Whisken as a staging point before the final two territories. It helps shorten the run back after deaths if the team can keep it uncontested.
fun_facts: A contested Whisken blocks forward deployment there until the fight resolves.

name: Bloodwhisk Reach
summary: Bloodwhisk Reach is the sixth flag territory and one of the last objectives before the final push.
role: Capture Bloodwhisk Reach to keep pressure near the end of the route. It is a valuable spawn because Whiskspire is the only reclaimable territory beyond it.
fun_facts: Bloodwhisk Reach has thirteen deploy spawn points, second only to Whiskspire.

name: Whiskspire
summary: Whiskspire is the seventh flag territory and the last reclaimable point in the route.
role: Take and hold Whiskspire as part of the final checklist for unlocking the boss route in Traditional.
fun_facts: Whiskspire gives the largest forward deployment spread, with fourteen spawn points.
